newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's sees more Australian banks mergers.
newsitem.headline: Moody's sees more Australian banks mergers.

text.p: Credit rating agency Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it expected some of Australia's major banks to merge in response to a squeeze on lending margins and profitability.
Moody's Australian bank specialist, Sean Jones, said mergers among Australia's six independent banks would be seen, at worst, as a neutral move for bank creditors and depositors.

The remaining independent banks are National Australia Bank , Westpac Banking Corp the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, Commonwealth Bank of Australia , Adelaide Bank and Macquarie Bank, he said.
